payload.summary: Ward Flow: wards/ward-overview.module.css is orphan CSS with no component at all
payload.detail: MEASURED 2026-09-04: 'find src -iname *ward-overview*' returns the stylesheet and nothing else — no component, no route, no importer. It is not a planned screen with its styling ready; it is a stylesheet for something that does not exist. It is the single remaining row in KNOWN_UNFIXED in tests/ward-management-print-coverage.test.ts, exempted because fixing print coverage on a file nothing mounts is work with no effect. Deleting it is an owner call under the protected-work rule, not an integrator's. Options: delete, or keep with a recorded reason if a ward-overview screen is still intended.
